newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African Reserve Bank injects liquidity - dealers.
newsitem.headline: S.African Reserve Bank injects liquidity - dealers.

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank moved to inject liquidity into the foreign exchange market on Thursday as the rand came within a whisker of its all-time low against the dollar, dealers said.
They said the Bank was offering dollars above the 4.5825 level.
"The Reserve bank has been offering dollars above 4.5825 and the all the way up from there," a dealer said.
"They were also selling (dollars) a bit earlier," he said.
Another trader said: "The Bank has been around adding liquidity, and smoothing the rand's slide."
The rand was last trading at 4.5850/5900 its lowest level since August 19 when it hit a record 4.59 bid in after-hours trade.
